content.short: Chronicle Protocol provides scalable, cost-efficient, decentralized oracles to overcome on-chain data limitations.
content.description: Chronicle Protocol is a blockchain-agnostic data oracle focused on delivering scalable, secure, and resilient information feeds across diverse networks. At its core sits Scribe, an Oracle architecture developed by Chronicle Labs, engineered around five pillars: scalability, transparency, accessibility, resilience, and security. The project emerged in 2023 as a spin-out from the MakerDAO Oracle Core Unit, underscoring a commitment to open, interoperable data that can support decentralized finance and other on-chain applications without relying on a single chain or provider.
